ddl.value: length("username") between 3 and 32 and "username" not glob '*[^a-z0-9._-]*'
ddl.name: account_username_format

ddl.value: ("purpose" = 'invite' and ("account_id" is null or "redeemed_at" is not null)) or ("purpose" <> 'invite' and "account_id" is not null)
ddl.name: setup_link_account_by_purpose

ddl.value: ("purpose" <> 'first_setup' or "created_by" is null) and ("purpose" <> 'invite' or "created_by" is not null)
ddl.name: setup_link_author_by_purpose

ddl.value:
("area" is null or length("area") between 1 and 60)
        and ("phone" is null or length("phone") between 1 and 20)
        and ("address" is null or length("address") between 1 and 200)
        and ("note" is null or length("note") between 1 and 1000)
ddl.name: customer_details_length

ddl.value: json_valid("after") and ("before" is null or json_valid("before"))
ddl.name: order_change_json

ddl.value: "note" is null or length("note") between 1 and 1000
ddl.name: payment_note_length

ddl.value: "note" is null or length("note") between 1 and 1000
ddl.name: sales_order_note_length
